dialogue.text:
When I was recommending free boxes I could feel her
almost having a heart attack at the "free".
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
Like yeah, don't wanna give out free stuff,
but that's just 'n overexaggerated reaction.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
Went damn near pale when I mentioned giving out
those blue gems too.
dialogue.speaker: April
